title: Operations Manager
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

The Operations Manager will own day\-to\-day service operations across UtilStop's UAE/INDIA marketplace and support its India expansion — working closely with the India\-based tech and support team, UAE leadership, and local partners to keep service delivery, provider quality, and customer satisfaction consistent across every vertical and market.

**Service operations**

● Own end\-to\-end service delivery across all verticals, ensuring consistent quality and reliability.

● Build and manage a strong network of service providers, maintaining high performance standards.

**Customer experience**

● Ensure fast, reliable customer support and a consistently high standard of service across all channels.

● Own resolution of customer issues, keeping satisfaction and retention high.

● Lead and manage the customer happiness team, setting the standard for service excellence.

**Strategy \& growth**

● Help position and strategize UtilStop's service offering across markets.

● Identify and help launch new services and revenue streams as the business grows.

● Contribute to go\-to\-market and pricing strategy for new verticals and markets.

**Cross\-functional coordination**

● Work closely with tech, support, and business teams across regions to keep operations aligned.

● Support expansion into new markets and service categories.

**Performance \& reporting**

● Define and improve operating processes for booking, dispatch, and service completion.

● Track key operational metrics and report regularly to leadership.

**Requirements**

● 3\+ years in operations management, ideally in a marketplace, home services, field service, or aggregator business.

● Experience managing distributed or remote teams across multiple countries — UAE and India experience preferred.

● Comfortable building and managing vendor networks and service\-quality processes.

● Strong communication skills; fluent in English, with Arabic and/or Hindi a plus.

● Data\-driven — comfortable working with dashboards, KPIs, and reporting tools.

● Experience with franchise, licensing, or joint\-venture operating models is a plus.

**Nice to Have**

● Experience in the UAE and/or Indian home services or field\-service industry.

● Familiarity with WhatsApp Business API\-based customer support workflows.

● Experience with SaaS\-based scheduling or crew\-management tools.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
